headline: France Snatches Victory at Marengo; Austrian Army Routed in Northern Italy
dispatch: French forces under the First Consul reversed a day of near-certain defeat at Marengo yesterday when a relief column under General Desaix arrived at a critical moment and shattered the advancing Austrian line. The Habsburgs had pushed French troops back across the plain and believed the battle won before the fresh troops arrived. The triumph consolidates French dominance in northern Italy and reshapes the terms of any future peace.
answer: Napoleon wins Battle of Marengo against Austria, 1800
